description: Master and detail with a nested grid in Svelte 5. Expand any account row and a full-width detail row hosts another SvGrid listing that account's call records with their own sortable and filterable columns. It is built on the grid's isDetailRow and renderDetailRow props: the detail is a real colspan row, and its content happens to be a second grid.
keywords: svelte table expand to child table

faq.question: How do I put a grid inside a detail row?
faq.answer: Render <SvGrid> in the component passed as renderDetailRow, with data filtered to the master row's id. Each expanded account gets its own instance with independent sorting and filtering.

faq.question: How is the expand state tracked?
faq.answer: An open set of account ids in $state. A $derived inserts a detail marker row after each open account, and isDetailRow tells the grid which rows to render through renderDetailRow.

faq.question: Does the nested grid virtualize?
faq.answer: Yes, each nested grid is a normal grid with its own scroll container and containerHeight, so an account with thousands of calls stays smooth.
